source_mappings.semantics: Default unshuffled 12-fold KFold, intercept OLS, signed per-fold Pearson then arithmetic fold mean. This component scores supplied predictions; it does not run author inference or permutations.
66-dimension row join and global feature standardization feed original single-trial response encoding; no image-repeat averaging.
Source Pearson uses centered dot product divided by centered norms, suppresses divide warnings and returns NaN for zero-variance columns without replacement.

Every declared repeated-image trial and voxel retained without averaging or population intersection.
Signed within-session Pearson and equal-fold mean; per-voxel paired candidate-minus-author delta.
Safe NPZ read, input SHA256 binding and existing output preservation.
